name: go-service
title: Go service + Postgres (pgx/sqlc) + containers
summary: Go 1.22+ HTTP service: net/http ServeMux or chi, pgx over Postgres with sqlc-generated queries, goose (or atlas) SQL migrations, go test with optional testify, gofmt + golangci-lint, a multi-stage Dockerfile, deployed as an image to Fly.io, Cloud Run, or Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI.
recommended_for: a backend API or worker where one static binary, explicit control over the runtime, and boring inspectable SQL matter more than a paved front-end road
not_for: server-rendered web UIs, CLI tools with no service in them, or teams already committed to gin/echo/GORM conventions (README.md says what to adapt)

commands.install: go mod download && go mod verify
commands.e2e: go test ./... -race -count=1 -tags integration (DATABASE_URL must point at a throwaway Postgres)
commands.migrate_prod: scripts/migrate-prod.sh (confirmation-gated wrapper around goose up; see WORKFLOW.md)
commands.deploy: git push origin main (CI builds the image for the green SHA, then fly deploy --image | gcloud run deploy --image | kubectl apply; see WORKFLOW.md)

format_cmd: gofmt -w (post-edit-format.sh detects go.mod); goimports -w if installed
migration_tool: goose (plain SQL, -- +goose Up/Down; watermark = goose_db_version table; run goose fix before merge so mainline versions are sequential). atlas is the documented alternative.
date_helpers: internal/clock/clock.go (Clock interface with Now() so tests inject time; store UTC, format at the edge)
app_verifier_boot: docker compose up -d postgres (or any local Postgres 16), goose up against it, go run ./cmd/<service> (listens on :8080), then curl GET /healthz and the changed routes

overlay.rules: rules/*.md replace the core api-boundary/data-layer/services/scripts rules; delete the core ui.md (this profile has no UI)
overlay.qa_pack: none; post-deploy smoke checks live in cmd/tools/smoke-test
